title.narrative: ROAP/AFG03/23/Technical Assistance for Urban and Territorial Planning

description.narrative:
UN-Habitat HQ (PFE section) will provide training for UN-Habitat and UNDP project staff in Afghanistan in urban and territorial planning. It is anticipated that through the training, the two agencies in Afghanistan will strengthen their capacity to perform spatial analysis of both urban and rural human settlements, transport networks, regional economic hubs and corridors, etc which are vital for developing policies on the preservation and enhancement of urban-rural linkages, social inclusion and peace building, inclusive prosperity, and protection of the environment.
The following outputs will be achieved: Output 1: Brief report including analysis and diagnosis of the challenges and needs, data assessment, and recommendations on the next steps.
Output 2: Draft training package on spatial profiling and data, Spatial Development Framework, Regional Capital Investment Planning and a spatial profiling exercise for a selected district (thematic areas tbd based on the needs).
Output 3: Final training package on e.g. a manual/step-by-step guide in Spatial profiling and data, Spatial Development Framework, Regional Capital Investment Planning (thematic areas tbd based on the needs).
Output 4: Reporting including technical recommendations on the way forward
